cases.goal: Explain the fictional Courier service to an engineer migrating from v1 to v2: capacity limits and units, retention, delivery behavior, retry handling, regional availability, and unsettled documentation. Distinguish versions and dates, cite originals, and explicitly identify missing information.

facts.statement: Version 2 permits at most 80 messages per request.

evidence.quote: A v2 request may contain at most 80 messages.

facts.statement: Each v2 message has a 12 KiB body cap; a whole request has a separate 256 KiB aggregate cap.

evidence.quote: Each message may contain at most 12 KiB of body data.
The aggregate body data in one request may not exceed 256 KiB.

facts.statement: The v1 endpoint permits 20 messages per request.

evidence.quote: The old v1 endpoint permits 20 messages per request.

facts.statement: Retention is 9 days in v2 and 3 days in v1, measured from acceptance.

evidence.quote: In v2, accepted messages are retained for 9 days. In v1, accepted messages are retained for 3 days.
Retention starts at acceptance, not the first delivery attempt.

facts.statement: Version 2 is at-least-once and consumers may receive duplicates.

evidence.quote: Courier v2 provides at-least-once delivery.

facts.statement: HTTP 429 retries must wait for Retry-After.

evidence.quote: On HTTP 429, wait for the Retry-After value before retrying.

facts.statement: As of March 3 2026 v2 is available in North and West; South is still v1.

evidence.quote: As of this bulletin, v2 is available in North and West. South remains on v1.

facts.statement: The v2 visibility default is disputed: quick-start 45 seconds, operations runbook 60 seconds; unresolved.

evidence.quote: The v2 quick-start says the default visibility timeout is 45 seconds. The v2 operations runbook says the default visibility timeout is 60 seconds.
The discrepancy is unresolved; this note supplies no authority rule for selecting one value.

queries.question: For Courier v2, give the per-message body cap and aggregate request-body cap. Are these the same limit?

evidence.quote: Each message may contain at most 12 KiB of body data.
The aggregate body data in one request may not exceed 256 KiB.

queries.question: What changes in request message count and retention when moving from Courier v1 to v2?

evidence.quote: A v2 request may contain at most 80 messages.
The old v1 endpoint permits 20 messages per request.
In v2, accepted messages are retained for 9 days. In v1, accepted messages are retained for 3 days.

queries.question: As of March 3, 2026, can a new v2 queue use West or South?

evidence.quote: As of this bulletin, v2 is available in North and West. South remains on v1.

queries.question: What is the default Courier v2 visibility timeout?

evidence.quote: The v2 quick-start says the default visibility timeout is 45 seconds. The v2 operations runbook says the default visibility timeout is 60 seconds.

queries.question: What is the monthly price of Courier v2?

cases.goal: Explain current Morrow Tool Library borrowing and workshop access to a new member as of May 2026. Cover eligibility, simultaneous tool limits, loan periods and conditional renewals, after-hours check-in, and unsettled Saturday collection hours. Distinguish current public rules from retired policies, staff services and event examples. Cite original evidence and identify unknown details.

facts.statement: Take-home borrowing needs current membership and age 18 or older; supervised workshops admit age 16 or older without granting borrowing eligibility.

evidence.quote: Borrowing take-home tools requires a current member aged 18 or older.
Supervised workshops admit participants aged 16 or older.

facts.statement: The current simultaneous holding limit is 3 tools and each loan lasts 7 calendar days from checkout.

evidence.quote: A member may hold at most 3 take-home tools simultaneously.
Each take-home loan lasts 7 calendar days from checkout.

facts.statement: Only one renewal of 3 additional calendar days is allowed, conditional on no reservation.

evidence.quote: A take-home loan may be renewed once for 3 additional calendar days, but only if nobody has reserved the tool.

facts.statement: After-hours deposits are checked in on the next opening day, not at deposit time.

evidence.quote: Tools left in the after-hours return box are checked in on the next opening day.

facts.statement: Current Saturday collection notices conflict between 09:00 and 10:00 with no authority rule; unresolved.

evidence.quote: This current notice says Saturday tool collection opens at 09:00.
This current calendar says Saturday tool collection opens at 10:00.
The conflict with the current counter notice is unresolved; neither source is designated authoritative.

queries.question: Can a 17-year-old workshop participant take a tool home, and what separate eligibility rules apply?

evidence.quote: Borrowing take-home tools requires a current member aged 18 or older.
Supervised workshops admit participants aged 16 or older.

queries.question: Under the current rules, what is the take-home loan period, when is one renewal allowed and for how long, and when are after-hours deposits checked in?

evidence.quote: Each take-home loan lasts 7 calendar days from checkout.
A take-home loan may be renewed once for 3 additional calendar days, but only if nobody has reserved the tool.
Tools left in the after-hours return box are checked in on the next opening day.

queries.question: When does public Saturday tool collection open? Explain any unsettled evidence.

evidence.quote: This current notice says Saturday tool collection opens at 09:00.
This current calendar says Saturday tool collection opens at 10:00.
The conflict with the current counter notice is unresolved; neither source is designated authoritative.

queries.question: What is the monthly membership subscription price?

cases.goal: Explain the fictional Tern Archive visitor and research services, preserving date, building, ticket, and unit distinctions. Cover access, group visits, scanning, requested-material timing, and unsettled notices. Use original evidence and identify what remains unknown.

facts.statement: Reading Hall admission is age 16 or older; Exhibition Wing admits all ages.

evidence.quote: The Reading Hall admits visitors aged 16 or older. The Exhibition Wing admits all ages.

facts.statement: Reading Hall requires a free researcher card; Exhibition Wing does not.

evidence.quote: Reading Hall entry requires a free researcher card. Exhibition Wing entry does not require a researcher card.

facts.statement: Group visits allow at most 14 people and last 50 minutes.

evidence.quote: A group booking may include at most 14 visitors. Each booked tour lasts 50 minutes.

facts.statement: Group bookings need at least 6 calendar days notice.

evidence.quote: Groups must book at least 6 calendar days before arrival.

facts.statement: A self-service scan job is capped at 30 pages and 90 MiB aggregate output.

evidence.quote: One scan job may include at most 30 pages. The maximum output size of a scan job is 90 MiB.

facts.statement: Before 11:00 normally gives same-day 15:00 delivery; at or after 11:00 gives next opening day.

evidence.quote: Material requested before 11:00 is normally delivered by 15:00 the same day. Requests placed at or after 11:00 are normally delivered the next opening day.

facts.statement: At most 4 boxes can be held simultaneously; there is no stated daily request cap.

evidence.quote: A researcher may hold at most 4 boxes at a desk simultaneously.
The document gives no upper bound on the total number of boxes requested over an entire day.

facts.statement: Saturday Reading Hall opening is disputed between reception 09:30 and hall notice 10:00, unresolved.

evidence.quote: The reception notice says 09:30. The Reading Hall notice says 10:00.
The disagreement has not been resolved.

queries.question: Can a 12-year-old visit the Reading Hall or Exhibition Wing, and where is a researcher card required?

evidence.quote: The Reading Hall admits visitors aged 16 or older. The Exhibition Wing admits all ages.
Reading Hall entry requires a free researcher card. Exhibition Wing entry does not require a researcher card.

queries.question: Give the self-service scan job page and output-size caps.

evidence.quote: One scan job may include at most 30 pages. The maximum output size of a scan job is 90 MiB.

queries.question: How many calendar days ahead must a 14-person group book, and when would boxes requested at 10:00 normally arrive?

evidence.quote: Groups must book at least 6 calendar days before arrival.
Material requested before 11:00 is normally delivered by 15:00 the same day.

queries.question: At what time does the Reading Hall open on Saturday?

evidence.quote: The reception notice says 09:30. The Reading Hall notice says 10:00.

queries.question: How many parking spaces does Tern Archive have?
